systems.system: UMIRR integrated case-management software (logiciel intégré de gestion des interventions, de prévention et de répression des infractions liées aux VBG et aux violations des droits de l'enfant)
systems.country_label: système de gestion des cas de l'UMIRR
systems.owner: UMIRR (joint police and gendarmerie unit), set up in 2025 with UNDP and UNPOL (MINUSCA); training supported by the Office National de l'Informatique
systems.tiers: UMIRR unit; more than 1,595 victims recorded since it went into service, as of June 2026

note: The only system named is the UMIRR unit's case-management software for one class of offence (gender-based violence and child-rights violations): single-function, so no fact for station records.
